title: Finite-colimit-preserving functors between abelian categories are additive
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a functor preserving finite colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $F$ is additive: for all objects $X,Y$ and morphisms $f,g:X\to Y$, one has $F(f+g)=F(f)+F(g)$.
